update_cadence.product_rule: No dense product materialization of exact solicitation→award matches after join measurement below usefulness. On-demand PIN lookup may still run for rare true positives; empty answers are not permanently sticky.

join_measurement.strategy: exact_pin_temporal — Checkbook Agreement.pin equals City Record notice.pin and (approved_date || start_date) is strictly after notice.start_date. PIN-reuse without temporal is rejected.

join_measurement.verdict: Below usefulness threshold (~30%) on the modern product universe (0% temporal exact-PIN join). City Record RFQ-style pins and Checkbook Contracts_NYCHA pin values largely do not share a joinable key; PIN reuse produces pre-solicitation agreements the temporal filter correctly rejects. Disable product claims of dense exact NYCHA award matches; keep the ranker and non-sticky on-demand path for rare true positives.
